terra.problem: The text does not say how small the group is or establish that no one else accompanies Jeremiah.
Jeremiah is told to address the kings, but the text does not say the message reaches them or establish that a king is not among those accompanying him.
The geographical fact about Moab needs a reference outside this passage. Also, 'Wrong mailbox' uses 'wrong' about the baker's answer.
The text addresses the kings of Judah and residents of Jerusalem; it does not say they are standing near the valley.
The text says the people, their fathers, and the kings had not known these gods. It does not say the gods were brand new.
The text says passersby will be appalled and scoff; it does not say whether they will be moved to help.
The text does not say that nobody stops to help or bring bandages.
The text names what was done on the rooftops but does not say they were never used for relaxing.
The text does not say the opposite of praying toward the house of the LORD; it simply does not mention that action.
The statement that the Benjamin Gate is a real gate in Jerusalem is a fact from outside this passage and needs its own reference.
The first-person quote is the LORD's message, but the lead-in identifies Jeremiah rather than the LORD as its speaker.
